name: Bookings
tagline: Appointments customers can make without calling you

roadmap.note: Shipped. Single calendar, several services; deposits and calendar sync are deliberately not in v1.

marketing.summary: Publish your availability, let customers book themselves in, and send the reminders that stop no-shows. The assistant can take the booking mid-conversation instead of sending people to a separate page.
marketing.audience: Salons, clinics, trades, tutors, studios - anyone whose day is a calendar and whose phone rings during it.

features.title: Booked from the chat
features.body: A customer asking about availability can be booked in the same conversation, without being sent to another site.

features.title: Your real availability
features.body: Opening hours, breaks, service durations and buffer time, so the slots you offer are slots you can actually work.

features.title: Cancel without phoning you
features.body: The confirmation email carries a private link, so a customer who cannot make it cancels themselves and frees the slot instead of simply not turning up.

faq.q: Does it send reminders before the appointment?
faq.a: Not yet. Reminders need scheduled sending, which arrives with the next release. Bookings today confirms by email at the time of booking.

faq.q: Will it sync with my calendar?
faq.a: Not in this release. Two-way Google Calendar sync is a per-tenant authorisation project of its own, and we would rather ship a diary that is correct than a sync that is nearly right.

faq.q: Can I take a deposit at booking time?
faq.a: Not yet. Taking money into your account needs a payment setup we have not built, and half of it would be worse than none. Bookings v1 confirms the time; you take payment however you do today.
